name: Ultrasound Sector
desc: A curvilinear B-mode ultrasound fan from a transducer at the apex: Rayleigh speckle scrolling through the tissue, specular interfaces undulating as bright arcs, a pulsing organ wall throbbing on the cardiac cycle, and a colour Doppler box painting flow red-toward and blue-away inside a vessel — near-field bright, far-field softened by time-gain-compensated attenuation, shimmering the way live scanning does, as grey B-mode, colour Doppler, amber power Doppler, or a schematic of iso-echo contours.

energy.doc: overall echo gain — brightness of the tissue map

density.doc: speckle fineness — coarse tissue vs fine grain

depth.doc: attenuation depth — how quickly the far field darkens

flow.doc: Doppler flow strength inside the colour box

x.doc: pan across the sector when magnified

style.doc: grey B-mode / red-blue colour Doppler / amber power Doppler / blueprint of iso-echo contours
